crossRefs.note: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.

translations.web: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”
translations.bsb: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”
translations.kjv: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
translations.asv: But if thou utter this our business, then we shall be guiltless of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
